proposal.rationale: Explicit opt-in limits the trial to the default three-repeat mixed calibration on eight full-length streams. After the original warmup and two complete alternating rounds on this worker, every arm must have positive, finite samples within two percent before the method expands each observed range by a quarter percent on each side. It stops only if the smallest potentially eligible threshold must also be within two percent of the fastest under those bounds and must clear the original five-percent speed gate. Otherwise it measures the original third round in the original order. The measured upper median feeds the existing threshold and likelihood checks and all result fields. The full teacher-forced NLL, setter sequence through that check, and cleanup remain intact. The first two rounds predict the omitted round only under stable local timing, so the controller still needs to evaluate the complete worker.
